title: LLV-GBANK250C: compact half-log tables save logarithmic quantum space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the single physical LLV-GBANK250C interpreter of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md program recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch fully charged work is O(2^((1/2)sqrt nlog2n+(3/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. All original virtual parameters, source/leaf guards, finite search schedules, partial finishing calls, failed work and all-modulus decoders are preserved. Every measured-bank bit/address operation, full operand decoding, original coherent lookup gate, initialization, region clear, source SWAP and output-first cleanup is charged. The complete internal virtual time estimate and explicit strict asymptotic gap absorb the fixed polynomial simulator factor into this exact envelope; no final pure exponential is multiplied with an unreported polynomial. All five claims concern this same physical implementation. The current implementation actually uses the compact full-vector/two-label-root backing layout of proof.md Section3. Every new field-locator, allocation and address operation is charged within the fixed polynomial bank factor and exact strict time margin.

For the same physical LLV-GBANK250C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated classical space is O(n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. It includes N, output, a fixed number of O(n)-bit staging operands, complete short address/scan fields and finite controller code. All other labels, arrays, frames, return contexts, numeric loop/cap counters, arithmetic, generator and allocation metadata are in the counted basis-qubit bank, not a duplicate classical stack or measurement transcript. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK250C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated quantum space is O(n^(5/2)/log2n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Put ell=max(1,ceil log2n),lambda_bank=ceil(ell/2),E=2^lambda_bank,J=max(1,ceil(E/ell)). Seven fixed regions each C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2)))*J bits, C=2^48, bound the complete classical-virtual address span. A full-vector pool of2^20ceil(n/ell) slots of16nE bits covers all full tables; final two-label roots have a separate2^17n-slot pool of16n bits. Current tuples/input/source/decoder/arithmetic and all allocator metadata fit the same explicit capacities. Logical coherent cells span O(n), with all ID lists in the bank. The WHOLE paired prefix, every padding wire, coherent data, source scratch, failures, growth and cleanup count, with complete address fees. Section3 proves fixed maximum ranges and slot reuse independently of success. Since J=O(sqrt(n)/logn), total quantum allocation is O(n^(5/2)/logn), jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK250C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired source copies number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. The exact CQ/channel simulation makes precisely one physical acquisition per virtual acquisition and no others, preserving all failed, discarded, rejected and aborted requests and the original guards. Local zero bank/padding preparations are counted time and quantum storage, not DCP copies. The complete virtual proof establishes the literal main Qcap<=2^(sqrt(n)/2) and finite-prefix outside constant. Its unchanged full output law establishes success at least1-2^-8 jointly with every resource and error claim.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK250C algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N and secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and the entire secret is recovered with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The CQ simulation permits classical correlations between bank values and coherent registers but proves no transfer to an adaptive malformed supplier that observes extra bank measurements. No positive tolerance or impossibility of greater robustness is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
